_doc: Colombian Spanish slang scores in the same scale as NLP.js senticon ([-1, 1]). Entries are raw words; the loader stems them at runtime with @nlpjs/lang-es and merges them into the senticon dictionary, overriding the standard-Spanish score when the slang sense differs (e.g. 'brutal' means 'amazing' in Colombian use, not 'savage'). Words whose Spanish stem collides with an unrelated common term (e.g. 'mamera' → stem 'mam' overlaps 'mamá') are deliberately omitted.
